decisions.reason: Retaining production data during redeployment does not change the required prize-pool or draw-progress displays.
The deployment strategy does not alter any FAQ content or explanation requirement.
Safe redeployment with retained production data does not change fiat wallet provisioning or reward-access behavior.
The accepted contract redeployment strategy does not require a change to About-page content.
Data retention may preserve existing badge data, but it does not modify the badge set, award rules, or presentation requirement.
The contract upgrade strategy does not change the Mission-page copy.
Retaining production data does not change the required NFT image, metadata, or wallet-rendering behavior.
The redeployment and data-retention decision has no effect on the responsive badge-grid layout.
Retaining production data supports continuity but does not change the existing rule to display successfully minted, owned NFTs and exclude failed attempts.
The source preserves current production data but does not change any NFT reward-metadata field or accounting rule.
The contract redeployment strategy does not alter transactional email delivery or email contents.
Safe redeployment does not modify the rule governing when the Mint Successful modal appears.
